capability_ledger.evidence: user diary: 5 of 6 apps are non-urgent

open_decisions: Whether digest read state syncs across devices later
problem: Notification interruptions fragment focus, but users fear missing urgent messages, so they over-check every app.
requirements: R1: user can mark an app as low priority
R2: digests deliver at user-chosen times
risks: Users may misclassify urgent senders as low priority; mitigation is an allowlist override

goals: Batch low-priority notifications into two daily digests
Let urgent senders break through immediately

test_matrix: audit: no outbound network beyond app reads
privacy: notification content never leaves the device
rollback: unmarking an app restores instant delivery
user_flow: User selects apps as low priority; digests appear at chosen times; urgent notifications still arrive instantly; opening a digest lists items grouped by app with one-click open.
users: Knowledge workers on desktop who keep notifications enabled out of urgency fear.
